description:
## Finding
\`pkix-path/src/lib.rs\` (v0.2.0 package) contains many doc comments that still describe the code as v0.1:

- L509 (\`ValidationPolicy\` doc): \"Path-building (...) is **out of scope for v0.1**.\"
- L752 (\`ValidatedPath\`): \"\`ValidatedPath\` derives \`Copy\` and is committed to remain \`Copy\` in all v0.1.x releases.\" \"Any future field additions ... will be added in a new minor version (v0.2+)\"
- L800 (\`validate_path\`): \"See crate-level documentation for v0.1 scope limits.\"
- L1057 (\`PolicyNode\`): \"# Limitations (v0.1) Policy qualifiers (\`qualifier_set\` ...) are not stored ... Application-specific qualifier processing is deferred to v0.2.\"
- L1289–1290 (\`names_match\`): \"For v0.1: implements case-fold ... Full Unicode NFKD normalization is deferred to v0.2.\"
- L1408–1424 (\`any_to_str_bytes\`): \"v0.1 partial normalization\" / \"v0.2 planned — decode then normalize:\" — but this is v0.2 already and the work is not done.
- L1453: \"full Unicode case-folding (NFKC + case-fold) is deferred to v0.2.\"

## Why P1
Section 0 anchor — the package is v0.2.0; doc comments assert future v0.2 work that is overdue and treat the current version as v0.1. A reader cannot trust the documented scope when timeline references contradict the version they're reading.

## Fix
Three coherent options (pick one and apply consistently):
1. Bump every \"v0.2 planned\" reference to \"v0.3 planned\" with bd-tracked issues.
2. Implement the deferred items (NFKC, BMPString, qualifier_set) in v0.2.
3. Drop the version qualifiers entirely and use \"current limitation\" / \"future work\" without a version commitment.

Option 1 is the lowest-cost path consistent with the existing release.

## Scope reference
\`pkix-path/src/lib.rs:509,752,800,1057,1289-1290,1408-1424,1453\`.
title: P1: pkix-path/src/lib.rs has 7+ stale "v0.1" doc references in v0.2.0 code
